transport.mutation_scope: mutation_id required on every POST and receipts bound to connection+route+path identity
transport.byte_bound_note: Only To-Discourse content_html has the preserved 49152-byte HTML bound; response/body bounds do not impose a whole From-Discourse publication cap
transport.metadata_response_rule: Page adaptively below item maximum to respect byte bound. Never omit a required field or truncate a record; single oversized record fails metadata_unavailable.

bounds.url_history_retention: retain while binding/mapping exists, including withdrawn mappings; no automatic reuse
bounds.work_history_retention: retain latest state and unresolved work while mapping exists; retain settled detailed receipts for at least 365 days

rules: nil UUID is rejected

Url.format: absolute HTTPS URL without userinfo or fragment

Instant.format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ; valid UTC date; leap second value 60 rejected

Base64.format: canonical padded RFC 4648 base64; strict decode/re-encode comparison

Base64Url.format: canonical unpadded base64url; strict decode/re-encode comparison

rules: If both source times are known, updated_at >= created_at. Revision fixes every value in this object and its complete content.
Author IDs unique; primary_source_author_id, when provided on ToRecord, must name an entry in source_authors.
stream is required. Initial: cursor optional. Changes: cursor required. Duplicate/unknown query keys rejected.

Initial nonfinal: next_cursor nonnull, checkpoint null. Initial final: next null, checkpoint nonnull. Changes: checkpoint always nonnull; next nonnull only while draining the fixed current poll high-water mark.

Decoded content length <=32768. Offset + decoded length <= content_bytes. Nonfinal next_offset equals offset + decoded length and is strictly larger than offset. Final next_offset=null and offset+decoded length=content_bytes. Repeated request returns identical bytes for the same revision/offset.

Selection categories: category_ids nonempty; all_public: category_ids empty. Include/exclude lists unique and disjoint. Exclusion wins over category selection; include is not authority to publish private/deleted/draft content. Actual native author/taxonomy selections must be available in active catalogs. Only authorized Discourse administrators may write this policy; adapter route is read-only.
adoptable_resource_ids must be empty when existing_record_adoption=disabled; explicit_records_only admits exactly these current connection-owned From-Discourse resources, not arbitrary Core topics.

publication_lane is administrator-configured within this connection's allowed lanes. v2 source/mapping/work routes use that lane, without new caller authority. destination_origin is an origin, not a path or query URL.
Profile discourse uses NetworkConnection and network routes, not this CMS Connection object.

Reserves identity/URL only for an already eligible receiver-created publication intent. It does not enable policy or create publication work by caller request. Exact existing mapping returns that mapping; a mismatched external_id/URL is a conflict.

Hash describes only the native ownership receipt, excluding credentials. Receiver checks binding fields against authoritative stored records. Native adapter must actually validate the receipt under native lock; receiving this object alone is not independent proof of the native filesystem/database.

Local NativeOwnershipReceipt must bind current work generation; when proving a URL move it includes that move_id and public proof_nonce. Receiving a hash does not substitute for native receipt inspection.

Policy must explicitly admit this exact baseline resource for adoption. Receiver must match existing connection-owned from_discourse resource/topic/active external_id and URL before joining additive mapping state. Do not change existing record meaning.
Only a real native destination limit permits an excerpt. Read More URL equals authoritative source topic URL. No transport/body-page bound is a native publication limit.

source_revision nonnull for publish_revision and null for withdraw; attempt 0..3; terminal work cannot be reset for a new revision. Any lease generation exceeds all previous native generations for this mapping.
lease_generation is allocated from one durable monotonically increasing mapping fence counter. New work or explicit retry cycles never reset that counter; new claim advances it.
mapping_id, if supplied, filters already existing authorized pending work; it cannot create work.

Verifier fetched actual canonical public URL on the configured native origin without credentials or redirects and compared the expected source/native identity and native rendered representation. Hash is the declared verifier profile's native publication fragment, not a copied source marker.

Only withdraw work accepts this branch. URL equals current owned mapping URL. Native owned object is unpublished and HTTP response is 404 or 410; 401/403, network failure, or an unrelated URL do not prove withdrawal.
Transient classification is receiver-derived from the code. Caller cannot make a permanent conflict transient.
An abort is not a successful publication. A false or unverifiable restoration leaves attention; successful restoration preserves previous native/public revision and exact identity.

Ownership canonical_url and PublishedVerification.url equal proposed new URL; native ID/source revision/content hash match the current authoritative mapping/work. Native receipt/proof profile binds stored move_id and nonce.
Abort releases new URL only if no native change was applied and ownership still proves old URL. Otherwise attention/reconciliation; do not free a URL potentially carrying this publication.

Existing field bounds preserve v1 values; v2 existing_topic_id uses decimal CoreId string explicitly. Same source_revision with a changed payload conflicts. A new revision requires expected_source_revision matching the stored last source revision; initial creation requires null. Published native edits may invoke this route; draft/autosave/revision-object/page-view activity may not. Source-owned title/imported content updates stop at local/moderator ownership conflict rather than overwrite local discussion.

source_content_sha256/source_content_bytes describe the complete sanitized native source before excerpt selection. Full representation must match content_html bytes/hash exactly; bounded_excerpt requires source_content_bytes>49152 and must fit the existing HTML bound including Read More.
Read More URL equals canonical_url. Native source exceeds 49152-byte HTML delivery bound; serialized sanitized excerpt including link remains <=49152 bytes.

created/resolved/updated require all resource/topic/revision/time fields nonnull. reconciliation_required uses one of the four conflict/adoption reasons and all resource/topic/revision/time fields null; no other connection identity disclosed.
Metadata-only successor view; preserved v1 detail remains unchanged. From-Discourse content uses source revision routes.
retryable and HTTP status are fixed by error code; retry_after_seconds null for permanent errors and otherwise null or 1..3600.
kind must equal authoritative work.action. Publication and withdrawal preserve the same owned native object identity.

to_discourse only. Exact owned stable external/resource/topic binding; source revision initialized and current; reserve new URL on same permitted native origin. Body/title are not changed by URL migration.

Native adapter proves the same native source identity/content at new URL with issued nonce. new_source_revision is a fresh unused revision different from expected_source_revision, and verification.source_revision must equal it. Atomically update canonical URL/source metadata revision and actual source_updated_at only; retain title/body/content hash/count/native/external/resource/topic identity. Receiver receipt is not independent native proof.
Release new reservation only when no native move was applied and old URL ownership remains proven. Otherwise attention; retain both reservations until exact recovery.

Local durable native receipt, not a POST/GET body. SHA-256 over fixed field-order, 4-byte unsigned big-endian length-prefixed UTF-8 values; null encoded length 0xffffffff; integer encoded canonical decimal text. Never includes connection/lease/operator secrets.

Administrator selects only verified native capabilities. Caller capability claims remain descriptive and cannot grant scope or create work. An unavailable selected mode/native configuration stops publication rather than downgrade.
origin is approved HTTPS origin only; display name never supplies identity.
Created only by explicit native-administrator setup; copied active identity requires reconciliation.
Native administrator confirms exact peer UUID/origin by out-of-band comparison; not automatic capability enrollment.
Both administrators independently confirm unchanged forum identity/new origin; pause affected work until counterpart reapproval and credential rotation; do not auto-follow redirects.
Describes retained CMS binding, not complete missing CMS content or new CMS ownership.

Retain actual native-platform author IDs/names and available source times; unknown actual times null. CMS-derived publications use those authors rather than claiming the local bridge posting account authored native content.
Profile link belongs to actual owning forum; no matching-name account merge or automatic local account.
Exactly one raw_discourse and one cooked_html blob; each hash/count binds exact immutable bytes. All origin fields survive relay unchanged.
Same origin event/revision must match all immutable fields and bytes; no last arrival wins. CMS native_origin canonical source survives imported excerpts.
Origin category/tag IDs are descriptive original-native metadata only; category/tag metadata changes create a new publication revision without inventing a content edit time.
Issued by origin network forum; carried unchanged. Discussion and relay lists are subsets of recipients. Per-topic source rules may narrow connection ceilings, never broaden them.
Grant generation is durable monotonic per publication; relays preserve it and apply their own additional narrowing; list omission is not permission.
Path starts at origin forum, ends at immediate source; recipient absent, IDs unique, appending recipient cannot exceed eight forums.
Publication/origin bindings agree; target is in current origin grant and local peer ceiling. Immediate non-origin sender must be an admitted relay.
authority_expires_at = server_time + 300 seconds; recipient also uses monotonic 300-second lifetime from successful scoped response. Does not grant future authority after known revocation.
New policy enabled/relay_enabled/allow_local_discussion default false. Only public native eligible sources; received copies excluded except explicit relay.
Category and include/exclude rules match CMS policy; include lists cannot admit private/unpublished/deleted sources. Relay/recipient lists cannot exceed origin grant.

Category/topic/tag IDs are immediate source forum's native IDs, including its managed relay topics; do not confuse them with origin IDs. All required_tag_ids must be present, any excluded tag vetoes; required/excluded sets disjoint. Apply filters after approved origin/grant ceiling.
Native source administrator only; supplied fresh policy revision unique and current expected revision matches.
Default enabled/local_discussion_enabled/advertise_related_discussion false and representation_policy full_only; local admin selects public category and real local posting account.
Admin approval/normal local permissions cannot be replaced by peer headers. Native category and moderation are not overwritten on later source edits.
Source-issued Content Connection assigned exactly one directed peer pair; no implicit reverse grant or emitted secret.
Attach only a current locally owned explicit from_discourse Content Connection scoped to this peer origin/network lane; credential issuance/rotation remains native admin operation.
Credential stored separately protected server-side; never emitted. source/recipient must equal current validated export pair and local identity.

Native recipient admin only. Server validates exact source export pair with bounded same-origin HTTPS read before activation; no supplied capability can enroll peer. Request secret redacted from logs/errors/support output.
Origin retraction has origin-issued event ID/sequence and hides all owned copies; route_removal has null origin event fields and affects only that route.
Minimal tombstone; no private body/title/authors. Preserve dependencies until hidden or explicit attention.
Pinned snapshot/high-water mark and durable initial-to-changes transition follow CMS feed semantics; delivery_sequence orders one export, not different origin clocks.

Initial final checkpoint nonnull; changes checkpoint always nonnull. Store events durably before advancing; grant/withdraw controls remain readable for known deliveries when normal publication policy paused but credentials still enabled.
Same contiguous/chunk/final/hash/UTF-8 rules as ContentChunk. Current source scope required; no complete publication cap.
Only source-owned public native uploads, at most 8388608 bytes each; no arbitrary external URL fetch, credential forwarding, private/signed asset leak, or upload impersonation.
Pinned at exact publication/revision/asset_revision; adaptive page byte bound. Native asset references copied to local uploads; external URLs stay links, not server fetch instructions.
Chunk bounds/hash rules apply to binary bytes; complete UTF-8 requirement does not apply to binary assets.
Source stores per-hop scoped recipient report, not independent native proof; downstream completion is separate. Receipt local IDs bound durably after first create; no later rebind.

Publish revision/event nonnull; consent revision/event null; withdrawal origin sequence follows tombstone. attempt 0..3; durable source generation per delivery; native mapping has its own cross-route monotonic fence.
Use shared WorkState transitions restricted to dynamic network: no deployed/static prepare/finalize. Consent application does not create a native publication.
300 seconds and three-attempt/30-120-second shared discipline. Native receiving policy checked independently at every native mutation.

full_only means full publication actually applied; native-limit/constraint/Read More null. native_limit_excerpt requires actual measured native constraint and visible canonical Read More; never transport cap.
Import raw via native cooking; original blobs retained unchanged, asset URL rewriting recorded as native bytes. Do not insert peer cooked HTML directly as a native post.
Durable local mapping, native lock/fence/journal and exact local account/topic verified; native receipt is provenance fingerprint, not remote cryptographic proof.
Expected and observed owned-rendered-fragment hashes equal; actual native first post/provenance/selected presentation and appropriate source/local controls verified. Source marker alone insufficient.

Verify whole mirrored topic, replies and source projection denied to ordinary readers, including native search/feed/topic lists; staff retains native moderation. No local post deletion or global-erasure claim.
Effective permission is current source allow AND native recipient enable/topic override AND native user permission; source authority expires after 300 seconds locally unless refreshed.

origin_retraction requires hidden proof and remaining_authorized_route=false. Route removal may preserve same native copy only with another current origin-authorized route and public receipt; not proof of hidden topic.
remaining_authorized_route=true requires nonnull current remaining_route_verification and null hidden verification; false requires nonnull hidden verification and null remaining-route verification.
Never emits lease token.
Native source admin only; attention -> new audited cycle; no automatic worker retry bypass.
Origin grant unknown/expired/prohibited forces false regardless of override; local restrictions may narrow.
Unique local receiving forum + origin key; one topic shared by agreeing routes, not one topic per peer. Native mapping generation serializes all routes, independent of source lease numbers.
Default latest 20 replies, not first post; limit 1..100. Cursor pins older snapshot/order at source; no per-reader polling publication jobs.
Only source-public visible replies; source post ID never native local composer parent. First post remains managed publication, not duplicate source reply.
Unknown count null not zero; source ordering/context preserved. Atomic per-conversation current snapshot supplies connection feed checkpoint, which does not skip other publications' events.
Remove cached display immediately; no private/deleted reply body or authors in tombstone.
Connection-level pinned initial/latest-reply summaries and changes; snapshot continuation checkpoint rules match NetworkFeed; no per-topic/reader polling loop.
Original source cooked reply bytes verified then rendered only through db-source-discussion-html-1 native sanitizer/cache profile. No native local post is created.
Only explicitly advertised, currently ordinary-reader-public verified related forum topics admitted by origin/recipient policy; links are not imported reply panels.
Native source admin; only actual origin can originate global retraction. Relay may request removal of its owned route, preserving original origin.
State remains pending/attention until receiving proof; source request is not removal proof.

Local durable receipt under native locking, not accepted ownership claim from a peer. Hash declared scalar fields with NativeOwnershipReceipt length-prefixed serialization; excludes credentials/lease tokens.
All authorized incoming paths serialize through one durable local mapping fence, not per-export lease generation; source origin event order still prevents regression.
Only native topic reader with ordinary local topic access; no peer credential/header or upstream fetch on browser read. Shared cache/current source authority only.

warming/unavailable empty items and null count, no false source-empty claim. ready/stale require unexpired authority; known revocation denies source projection. Topic/user rights independently guard local composer.

Current native topic read permission and source cache authority required on every chunk. Bytes are native-sanitized complete projection; assemble/verify before display. No foreign native post created.
Current enabled/scoped stored connection only. No secret is emitted.
native_capabilities are stored descriptive native configuration, never authentication. Set via authorized administration and verified in component qualification.
to_discourse direction required. created=201, resolved/updated=200, reconciliation_required=409. Returned topic identity uses decimal string; v1 stays integer.
Records scoped to connection/origin/direction/lane.
resource_id UUID; unauthorized resources return resource_not_found, without disclosing another connection.

to_discourse direction only; exact owned binding marked withdrawn and future source delivery stopped. Does not delete/hide the forum topic or its discussion. Public privacy/deletion is forum-owned and is not promised by binding withdrawal.
from_discourse direction and current source policy required.
Path IDs UTF-8 percent encoded exactly once. Offset<=content_bytes; offset at end returns empty final chunk.
Read-only to adapter. Discourse administrator UI owns changes.
from_discourse only; unique key (connection_id,source_id); no caller-enabled policy or unilateral work.
Explicit existing-resource allowlist controlled by forum admin; no baseline record conversion.
At most 100 entries; private to owning enabled/scoped connection.
204 has no body. Claim one already existing work item; attempts increment atomically; no simultaneous live lease for a mapping.
No lease secret in status read.
Authority.work_id must equal path; renewal advances expiry but not lease_generation or attempt.
Authority matches path/current mapping/revision/policy/generation/token. Static work uses prepare/finalize for synchronized/verified; deployed acknowledgement may be recorded separately.
Dynamic synchronized branch uses action-matching SyncResult; deployed stage applies only to static work; verified stage uses action-matching Verification. A static verified receipt must use finalize.
Permanent errors -> attention. Transient errors -> retry_wait unless attempt ceiling reached.
static profile only. Bind transaction ID to exact work/generation/revision/native state; mark synchronized, never verified.
Action-matching SyncResult covers staged native publication and staged native withdrawal; must retain prior native/public result for abort.
static publish_revision or withdraw. Exact current prepared transaction, deployment receipt and action-matching public/absence verification required; success verified.
static only; verified work cannot be aborted. Records failure/attention, never successful publication.
Reserve new URL while old URL remains active. Authority mapping must equal path; native identity cannot change.
Current authorized lease and revision; nonce/ancestry/current native identity and public new-URL verification match. Atomically switch URL and retire/reserve old URL.
Only unapplied native move may release new URL. Ambiguous/partial applied native move -> attention, retain reservations.
Descriptive data only. Does not change policy, scope, or create work.
Sequential zero-based pages of <=100 entries; duplicate same page accepted only if semantically identical; total body bound applies.
Exact declared total and unique entry IDs; atomic active snapshot switch. Old snapshot remains active on any failure. Response gives first bounded page, not entire catalog.
Catalog private to owning connection; scoped origin enforced.
Reserve same-origin new source URL for exact current owned to_discourse record. No body/topic rebind.
Current source revision and move nonce, exact native ancestry and public new-URL receipt; retire old URL atomically.
No applied native move: abort. Applied/uncertain move: attention; do not free reservations.
to_discourse only; scoped URL ancestry, not another connection's URL inventory.
Before explicit setup: resource_not_found; read never allocates identity.
204 bodyless; only existing currently admitted per-recipient work; paused publication admits control work only.
Native visible topic/mapping only; current shared cache, no remote polling/credential exposure; unauthenticated readers allowed only if normal native public topic rights allow.
Current native topic permission plus exact source-post/cache binding and source authority expiry; no arbitrary foreign identity lookup.

discourse_network.trust_model: Explicitly approved immediate peer and named origin/destination/relay ceilings; delegated trust, not end-to-end cryptographic origin proof
discourse_network.local_copy: One native mapping/topic per local forum+origin, agreeing paths share it; per-hop receipts and separate global native fence
discourse_network.discussion: One receiving topic; source read projection plus bilateral-consented local native replies; no multi-writer synchronization

excluded_features.operator_control: Removed from active contract, examples and cases; separate old control files remain excluded. Support assistance needs its own direction.
excluded_features.reply_federation: No multi-writer synchronization, source inline composer or account federation
